resources.string: Hold an NFC tag near your device.
That tag doesn\'t contain a supported text transfer.
That NFC message is invalid or damaged.
That tag contains multiple possible text records, so BeauTyXT won\'t guess which one to use.
That NFC message exceeds the 256 KiB message limit.
The tag could not be read. Keep it still and try again.
That NFC transfer could not be verified.
NFC processing is unavailable right now. Try again.
Ready. Hold a writable NFC tag near your device.
This tag is not NDEF-formatted. BeauTyXT does not format tags automatically.
This NFC tag is read-only. Try a writable tag.
The tag could not be written and verified. Keep it still and try again.
Writing replaces the tag\'s existing NDEF message. Start only when the intended tag is ready.
Tag label %1$s. Write this label on the physical tag.
%1$s · %2$s of %3$s text bytes. The complete NDEF message needs %4$s; the touched tag\'s capacity is checked before writing. The prepared transfer stays in memory and is discarded when you leave.

BeauTyXT transfers, NFC Forum Text and URI records, supported text MIME records, and single-URI Smart Posters are accepted. Nothing is opened or executed automatically; received text stays in memory until you choose Save.
This tag can hold %1$s, but this transfer needs %2$s. Try a larger writable tag.
Writing was interrupted. The tag may have changed. Read it to check, or start writing again.
Long poster title shortened for review.
The URI is inert editable text. BeauTyXT will not navigate to it automatically.
Shown only for this read. It may change or be copied and is not used as the tag\'s identity.
The HTML source remains editable. Markdown preview renders only BeauTyXT\'s safe semantic subset in Compose; scripts, attributes, CSS, and unsupported elements are never executed.
